messages:
Ethan R.: dropping notes from the roadmap sync: we need clearer launch definitions for routing policy and multi-region isolation.
Nina (PM): agreed. customers keep asking for explicit "residency-first" guarantees and predictable burst plans. list incoming.
Marco Eng: for runtime we should split work: control-plane policy authoring (common DSL) vs runtime enforcement (phased). control-plane day1, enforcement incremental.
Priya S.: sales: top asks are residency SLA, tenant-level route overrides, and soft-failover guarantees during region outages.
Ethan R.: proposed acceptance criteria for residency SLA: 99.9% region-local success, documented fallback semantics, and signed customer contract.
Marco Eng: technical constraints: KV cache localities, model weights locality, and quantized model replication cost. need cost estimates before committing.
DevRel Bot: auto-note: sync recording + deck: https://tiny.redwood/orch-deck-2025
Nina (PM): draft prioritization rubric: impact (customer revenue & regulatory), engineering effort, infra cost, external deps. score 1-5 and band.
Priya S.: can we explicitly mark "regulated" customers as critical for residency? they will pay for Private or Dedicated.
Ethan R.: yes. propose policy: if tenant.tag==regulated -> route_preference: region-only and no cross-region fallback without explicit consent.
Marco Eng: implementation idea: policy DSL example -> {"rules":[{"when":"tenant.tag==\"regulated\"","action":"prefer_region_local","allow_fallback":false}]}
Nina (PM): need launch gates. short list:
- security: KMS + audit logs
- telemetry: route_decision_id, model_variant, fallback_reason
- perf: p95 latency within 1.3x baseline for region-local
- rollout: canary < 1% failure delta
Priya S.: customers also want a per-tenant override UI in Console. track as high priority for Q3.
Ethan R.: action items:
- Marco: cost estimate for model replication and cache TTL strategies (due Wed)
- Nina: map top 12 customer asks to bands and draft messaging (due Fri)
- Priya: collect legal/regulatory checklist for residency customers (due Thu)
- Ethan: spec minimal policy DSL and backward compatibility plan (due Mon)
Marco Eng: will prototype a fallback invariant: if cache_miss && region_mismatch -> serve from local proxy with token-limit cap. sketch in PR.
Nina (PM): OK. next sync we'll review the DSL draft and the customer-band mapping. thanks everyone.
DevRel Bot: reminder: product/arch sync weekly Wed 15:00 UTC.
